steps.title: Dry and Prepare Filters
steps.instruction: Prepare filters preserved in 96% ethanol for transfer to Longmire Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Place the filter on a clean glass or plastic Petri dish and pour approximately 500 µl of the liquid (EtOH2) onto the filter; homogenize thoroughly before collecting the volume.
Place samples in the muffle at 25°C for 1 hour (or until fully dried), ensuring drying time does not exceed 2 hours.

steps.title: Filter Storage and Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Soak and store filters in Longmire Buffer and aliquot for processing.

substeps.instruction: Soak the filter in extraction buffer (Longmire Buffer) and store at -20°C.
Place ½ filter membrane in a new 1.5 Eppendorf tube with 900 µl of Longmire Eppendorf; store the remaining filter for future use.

steps.title: Sample Homogenization and Heat Shock
steps.instruction: Mechanically break down the filter and perform initial heat shocks.

substeps.instruction: Using sterile scissors, cut the filters submerged in Longmire Buffer into small pieces within the Eppendorf tube.
Perform a heat shock at 95°C for 10 minutes, then allow samples to cool to room temperature.
Vortex the samples for 5–10 seconds to ensure homogenization.
Perform a second heat-shock at 95°C for 10 minutes and allow samples to temperate at room temperature.
Add 9 µl of proteinase K at 20 mg/ml (final concentration of 0.2 mg/ml per sample).
Vortex for 30 seconds to mix; repeat this process two times with a 2-minute waiting period between each vortexing.

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform-Isoamyl Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the first organic extraction to remove proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl of vacuum grease with a syringe onto the wall of a 2 ml Eppendorf tube (prepare 2 sets of tubes per sample).
Add 800 µl of 25:24:1 phenol-chloroform-isoamyl pH 8 to the first set of grease tubes.
Vortex the sample for 5–10 seconds, homogenize using a pipette, and collect 800 µl of the supernatant.
Add the supernatant to the first grease tube and vortex until a uniform white phase is achieved throughout the tube.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 13300 rpm (at 4°C or room temperature), then cool down for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Chloroform-Isoamyl Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the second organic extraction to further purify DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 800 µl of 24:1 chloroform:isoamyl to the second set of grease tubes.
Carefully transfer the upper phase from the previous tube into the second grease tube, ensuring the pipette tip does not touch the grease layer.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 13300 rpm.
Carefully transfer the upper phase into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube without transferring any grease.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA using isopropanol and salt.

substeps.instruction: Add 800 µl of isopropanol and 34 µl of 5M NaCl.
Mix by inversion and incubate overnight at 4°C.
Centrifuge for 30 minutes at 13300 rpm at room temperature (or 4°C).
Cool down the samples after centrifugation and slowly pour off the aqueous phase.

steps.title: DNA Washing and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet and dry it.

substeps.instruction: Wash samples with 800 µl of 80% iced Ethanol and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 13300 rpm.
Repeat the wash step two times (repeat 1-2 more times for samples likely to experience PCR inhibition).
Slowly pour off the liquid and dry at room temperature until dry.

steps.title: DNA Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried DNA in ultrapure water.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in 50-75 µl of ultrapure water at 37°C.
Place samples in a 37°C water bath for 10 minutes to maximize elution and recovery.
